heading.title: Of Grant of Probate and Letters of Administration

article.title: Citation before grant of administration to legatee other than universal or residuary.
article.content:
235Citation before grant of administration to legatee other than universal or residuary.

Section 235  ·  Part IX · Chapter I  ·  page 71 of the Act
Letters of administration with the will annexed shall not be granted to any legatee other than an universal or a residuary legatee, until a citation has been issued and published in the manner hereinafter mentioned, calling on the next-of-kin to accept or refuse letters of administration.
